item.title: In the 1970s, a New Mexico architect built Earthships from tyres and cans for extreme weather
item.description: Michael Reynolds pioneered the Earthship concept, creating innovative homes constructed from repurposed materials that encourage self-sufficiency. These structures harness recycled resources and natural systems for energy and water usage. Earthships serve as a robust solution against infrastructure breakdowns and natural calamities. This approach is now shaping a wider trend in sustainable construction practices, showcasing an off-grid living model. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
